title: Contact
description: Contact details beside a message form, composing the @moderno-ui/{framework} Field, Button and Alert primitives: a serif heading, a sentence of introduction, then an email, a phone number and an office address, each with its own inline icon, and a name, email and message form with its own disabled, loading, error and sent renders; responds to its container (@container) — the reply note sits beside the send button at @sm, the heading steps up and name and email pair off at @md, and the details move beside the form with more room above and below at @lg.
